# Continual-ARC stream solving

Apply to ARC-style grid tasks delivered as separate stream instances with a persistent per-task Python transform and exactly one JSON action per response.

## Required workflow

1. Check the exact task-ID file under `workspace/programs/<task id>.py` before analysis or demos. If present, run its `transform(grid)` on the test input and submit that result first. Never replace an existing solution with an identity stub.

            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and

                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            top = min(y for y, _ in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, _ in cells)
            left = min(x for _, x in cells)
            right = max(x for _, x in cells)
            if bottom - top < 2 or right - left < 2:

            cellset = set(cells)
            clipped_bottom = bottom == h - 1
            clipped_right = right == w - 1
            if not all((top, x) in cellset and

                       for x in range(left, right + 1)):

            if not all((y, left) in cellset and
                       (clipped_right or (y, right) in cellset)

            core_bottom = bottom if clipped_bottom else bottom - 1

                    for x in range(left + 1, core_right + 1)
